meta.name: remotion-render
meta.description: Render videos from React/Remotion component code via inference.sh. Pass TSX code, get MP4. Supports all Remotion APIs: useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig, spring, interpolate, AbsoluteFill, Sequence. Configurable resolution, FPS, duration, codec. Use for: programmatic video generation, animated graphics, motion design, data-driven videos, React animations to video. Triggers: remotion, render video from code, tsx to video, react video, programmatic video, remotion render, code to video, animated video, motion graphics code, react animation video

copy.tagline: 把 React 组件代码渲染成 MP4 视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要用代码批量生成视频或动画
copy.tagline_en: Render React components into MP4 videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate videos or animations programmatically

howto.what: 装上后,你把 React/Remotion 的 TSX 组件代码交给 Claude,它会通过 inference.sh 的 belt CLI 提交渲染,产出 MP4 视频,并可设置分辨率、帧率、时长、编码格式。
howto.when: 当你提到 “remotion”、“tsx to video” 等关键词,或要把 React 代码渲染成视频时触发;前提是先装好 belt CLI 并执行 belt login。

say.text: 用 spring 动画渲染一段 1080x1080、60fps、2 秒的视频
say.note: 按你给的参数渲染弹簧缩放动画

say.text: 给组件传入 props:title 和 subtitle,再渲染成视频
say.note: props 会随输入传给组件

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude takes your React/Remotion TSX component code, submits it to render via the inference.sh belt CLI, and returns an MP4 video. Resolution, FPS, duration and codec are configurable.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'remotion', 'tsx to video' and similar keywords, or ask to render React code into a video. Requires the belt CLI installed and a belt login.

say_en.text: Render this Remotion TSX as a 3-second, 30fps 1920x1080 MP4
say_en.note: Claude runs belt app run and returns the video URL
Renders spring scale animation with your params
